2607.22100.title: MEUSLI: a Multilingual Projector for LLM-based ASR and Beyond
2607.22100.paper_summary: Lightweight projectors are an established way to connect pre-trained speech encoders with large language models (LLMs), mapping acoustic features into token-level embeddings for tasks like ASR and spoken question answering. Existing systems, however, typically only support a few languages and are often limited to English. We introduce MEUSLI, the first open-science multilingual projector family that links a Whisper encoder with open-source multilingual LLMs, enabling fully open-source end-to-end ASR in 28 European languages. MEUSLI extends prior monolingual pipelines, delivering strong results across high- and low-resource languages. Using proper continual leaning techniques, MEUSLI can be easily extended to other languages not seen in training. We further demonstrate that the MEUSLI projector can be leveraged beyond ASR, enabling multilingual speech translation and topic identification with only a few hours of task specific supervision per language. Overall, MEUSLI provides a solid foundation for multilingual speech understanding tasks, supporting scalable and inclu- sive open-source SpeechLLM
2607.22100.paper_summary_zh: 輕量級投影儀已成為將預訓練語音編碼器與大型語言模型（LLMs）連接的既定方式，將聲學特徵映射到令牌級嵌入，用於自動語音識別（ASR）和口語問題回答等任務。然而，現有系統通常僅支持少數語言，且往往僅限於英語。我們介紹了MEUSLI，第一個開放科學的多語言投影儀系列，將Whisper編碼器與開源多語言LLMs鏈接，實現了在28種歐洲語言中的完全開源端到端ASR。MEUSLI擴展了先前的單語管道，在高資源和低資源語言中均提供了強勁的結果。通過使用適當的持續學習技術，MEUSLI可以輕鬆擴展到訓練中未見的其他語言。我們進一步展示了MEUSLI投影儀可以超越ASR的應用，僅需每種語言幾小時的任務特定監督即可實現多語言語音翻譯和主題識別。總體而言，MEUSLI為多語言語音理解任務提供了堅實的基礎，支持可擴展和包容性的開源SpeechLLM。
